function erase(item: { value?: { name?: string } }) {
  if (item.value?.name) {
    delete item.value;
    const result: undefined = item.value;
    console.log(result, "value" in item);
  }
}
function eraseOptional(item?: { value?: string }) {
  delete item?.value;
  if (item) {
    const result: undefined = item.value;
    console.log(result);
  }
}
function eraseComputed(item: { value?: string }) {
  if (item.value) {
    delete item["value"];
    if ("value" in item) console.log(item.value.toUpperCase());
  }
}
function eraseThenAssign(item: { value?: string }) {
  if (!item.value) return;
  delete item.value;
  item.value = "new";
  console.log(item.value.toUpperCase());
}
erase({ value: { name: "entry" } });
eraseOptional({ value: "entry" });
eraseOptional();
eraseComputed({ value: "entry" });
eraseThenAssign({ value: "entry" });
